headword: {共用|きょうよう}{部分|ぶぶん}

definitions.gloss: shared area; common area; common-use space
definitions.explanation: Areas in an apartment building or condominium that are shared by all residents, such as hallways, lobbies, elevators, and parking lots. Contrasted with the individual units owned or rented by each resident.

examples.japanese: {共用|きょうよう}{部分|ぶぶん}は{清潔|せいけつ}に{保|たも}つ。
{共用|きょうよう}{部分|ぶぶん}に{荷物|にもつ}を{置|お}かないでください。
examples.english: Please do not leave belongings in the common areas.

examples.japanese: マンションの{共用|きょうよう}{部分|ぶぶん}の{修繕|しゅうぜん}は{管理|かんり}{費|ひ}でまかなわれる。
examples.english: Repairs to the shared areas of the apartment building are covered by the management fee.

notes:
A real estate and housing management term combining {共用|きょうよう} (shared use) and {部分|ぶぶん} (area/part). Important for anyone living in a Japanese apartment building, as rules governing shared spaces are strictly enforced.

COMMON SHARED AREAS:
- エントランス / ロビー: entrance / lobby
- {廊下|ろうか}: hallways
- エレベーター: elevators
- {階段|かいだん}: stairs
- ゴミ{置|お}き{場|ば}: trash collection area
- {駐輪場|ちゅうりんじょう}: bicycle parking area
- {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}: parking lot

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {共用|きょうよう}{部分|ぶぶん}の{使用|しよう}ルール: rules for using shared areas
- {共用|きょうよう}{部分|ぶぶん}の{清掃|せいそう}: cleaning of shared areas

OPPOSITE:
- {専有|せんゆう}{部分|ぶぶん}: exclusive-use area — the individual unit belonging to each resident
